Recent Developments & News: Dabur has recently faced regulatory scrutiny from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) over claims on its product labels, particularly "100%" claims on food products like honey and ghee. The FSSAI issued a prohibitory order to stop the sale of these products, citing misleading claims. Dabur challenged this in the Delhi High Court, which granted a stay on the directive, noting the lack of a hearing opportunity for Dabur. The company maintains that its claims comply with legal standards and are consistent with industry practices. Dabur has also accused FSSAI of bias, suggesting the order favors rival manufacturers. The matter is set for further hearing on August 24. Meanwhile, Dabur has begun transitioning its labels to remove the "100%" claims.
